items.t: Under Armour Refines Its Product Assortment to Drive Full-Price Sales
items.sum: UAA sharpens its product lineup to drive full-price sales, betting on performance gear and fewer styles while managing weak demand and inventory pressure.

items.t: Nike's Extra $5 Billion Still Leaves Sales Below 2024
items.sum: Nike stock fell 6.3% on Tuesday and closed at $35.85. The S&P 500 slipped 1.0% the same day. So Nike did 5.3 percentage points worse than the market. The drop came on the day Nike held its first investor day in nine years.
